_readme: 영어 축제 수동 교정(2026-09-30~, 영어 세션). TourAPI 영문 DB(festivals_en.json)는 매일 자동 갱신으로 덮이므로 교정은 여기에만 둔다. en-fix.js 가 build.js·festival-en.js 에서 적용. ko: {title,addr} = 지도 복사 칸 한글 원제·주소 지정, null = 좌표만 겹친 «다른 축제» 이름이 붙던 것을 숨김. 날짜는 주최측 공식 발표로만 고친다(src 필수). 공식 날짜가 TourAPI 영문과 같아지면 이 항목을 지운다.

3310546.addr: Citizens' Welfare Town Plaza (Donam-dong), Jeju-si, Jeju-do

intro.place: Citizens' Welfare Town Plaza area in Jeju City, plus venues across Jeju Island
intro.org: Jeju Federation of Arts & Culture (Jeju Yechong)

3310546.note: The 65th Tamna Culture Festival runs Oct 17–21, 2026. The main venue has moved to Citizens' Welfare Town Plaza in Jeju City (in 2025 it was the Tapdong seafront). The opening ceremony is on Oct 17 at 7:30 pm, and this year the festival coincides with the National Sports Festival held in Jeju, so expect Jeju City to be busier than usual.

3307792.note: 2026 marks the 100th anniversary of Hangeul Day, and the festival runs three days, Oct 9–11, 2026, at Sejong Central Park and Sejong Lake Park. A drone light show of about 2,000 drones is planned for the first night (Oct 9).

1385298.note: The 21st Busan Fireworks Festival is on Saturday, Nov 7, 2026, over Gwangalli Beach, with the show also visible from the Igidae and Dongbaekseom areas. Paid seats (R seats with a table, S seats with a chair) are sold by the organizer through NOL Ticket; the early-bird batch sold out within a minute.
